title: Control baselines (random picks; favorites only) for every leaderboard run
method: Computed on the same walk-forward sample as the signal strategies so skill can be separated from luck. Favorites-only uses current standings win% (a known, disclosed limitation: not point-in-time).

rows.note: seeded (20261115) random side per game; price-independent
point-in-time: higher cumulative win% through the week BEFORE the game, from official results (no look-ahead)
